member.name: T:TraceNameSpace.BugslayerStackTrace
member.summary: A stack trace class that actually works to get the source and line information when you call ToString. The class in the VS.NET V1 bits never seems to include the source and line even though the documentation says it does. If you don't care about getting the source and line with a stack trace, use the StackTrace class directly.
